01-hero.headline: Your battery's new best friend
01-hero.subline: A cute buddy who reacts to your real battery — and helps it last longer.

02-moods.headline: Volt mirrors your battery's mood
02-moods.subline: Happy when healthy, sleepy when low, sweaty when hot. One glance and you just know.

03-alert.headline: Know exactly when to unplug
03-alert.subline: Gentle alerts at 80% and on low battery keep Volt — and your battery — in the healthy zone.

04-care.headline: Turn battery care into a streak
04-care.subline: Stay in the 20-80% green zone, grow your streak and earn badges. Your Battery Care score out of 100.

05-widget.headline: Volt lives on your Home Screen
05-widget.subline: A widget and Live Activity show Volt's mood and charge at a glance — no need to open the app.

06-pro.headline: One tap. No ads. Forever.
06-pro.subline: Unlock full history, premium cosmetics and deluxe widgets with a one-time purchase. No subscription.

02-moods.headline: Volt fühlt, was dein Akku fühlt
